payload.title: Agents work as the Story's persona
payload.description:
The context pack gets a persona layer for the reporter, copywriter and editor profiles (and the announcement writer): the persona's name, instructions and voice notes, placed after the site's writing guidelines and policies and never overriding them. The pack hash includes the persona version, so a draft records which persona version shaped it.
Scenario: a copywriter pack for a Story with persona A contains A's instructions and no other persona's. Scenario: a site with personas off gets the same pack as today.
